modifiedFiles.summary: Removed BENCHMARK_EXACT_COORD_TOLERANCE_DEG = 0.0005 and replaced it with isRegisteredUnmodifiedBenchmarkMatch requiring explicit registered benchmark farmId, exact coordinate equality (zero spatial tolerance), unmodified draft state, no polygon input, and UPPSALA_REFERENCE_INPUT_REVISION for Uppsala.
Extended SiteCheckRequestSchema and evaluateSiteCapabilityCheck call to accept and forward inputRevision and isUserCreatedDraft.
Forwarded inputRevision, isUserModifiedDraft, and isUserCreatedDraft in /api/capabilities/site-check requests.
Forwarded inputRevision, isUserModifiedDraft, and isUserCreatedDraft in /api/capabilities/site-check requests.

Required UPPSALA_REFERENCE_INPUT_REVISION, exact [17.6389, 59.8586] coordinates, fieldCount === 3, and unmodified state before unlocking Uppsala M14 archive; added active-job idempotency (findActiveJobForRevision); enforced bound farmId, inputRevision, reportId, and evidenceVerified === true on upstream COMPLETED_VERIFIED responses.

Added report-grounded AI chat gateway service enforcing fail-closed default, HTTPS + ASTRAGRON_CHAT_ALLOWED_HOSTS allowlist, redirect: 'error', bounded timeout, sliding-window rate limiting, server-side report ownership and inputRevision verification, conversation-thread binding, and strict Zod output/citation verification against server-resolved evidence IDs.
Routed POST /api/reports/[reportId]/chat through handleReportGroundedChatRequest with owner identity and client rate-limit key extraction.

Updated reportGroundedChat capability readiness to use evaluateChatGatewayReadiness() so chat remains NOT_CONNECTED unless HTTPS endpoint, host allowlist, and ASTRAGRON_CHAT_ENABLE_VERIFIED_GATEWAY=1 are valid.
Updated benchmark site-check unit tests to pass registered benchmark farmId and UPPSALA_REFERENCE_INPUT_REVISION and verified custom-user-uppsala returns UNKNOWN_UNASSESSED.

Added dedicated integration test suite covering Gate G2 zero-leakage benchmark checks, Gate G3 job store anti-spoofing/idempotency/upstream provenance checks, and Gate G4 chat gateway security/ownership/citation checks.
Added live E2E assertion in SF-3 proving custom farm at Svalbard coordinates returns UNKNOWN_UNASSESSED before testing the registered SJ_SVALBARD_POLAR unsupported toast and non-blocking save flow.
Added source-derived API contract correcting all route, env var, persistence, and live FTW proof documentation drift.
Synchronized final handoff documentation with CODEX_ACTUAL_API_CONTRACT.md.
